ei.title: Evolution of Cultural Tourism to Daily Life
ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: Today's cultural tourist is just as likely to be in search of 'popular', 'everyday' or 'street' culture as they are likely to visit a heritage site or a museum. The museum seems to have lost its dominant role as a factory of meaning in (post)modern society, so cultural tourists have gone in search of meaning elsewhere. The predominant direction of expansion has been into 'everyday life'. Cultural tourism is as much based on experiencing as it is on seeing; therefore, Raymond Williams' definitions of culture as a whole way of life as well as the arts and learning are particularly relevant here. Past definitions of cultural tourism have placed too much emphasis on cultural tourism as a form of arts or heritage tourism in its narrowest sense; for example, visiting museums, monuments, galleries and theatres. Cultural tourists are also interested in the more experiential aspects of culture. In an international context, particularly in the context of indigenous or ethnic tourism, the way of life of a people can be a central focus, where the traveller is motivated primarily by first-hand, authentic or intimate contact with people whose ethnic or cultural background is different from their own.

det.korean: (A)dominant(지배적인) (B)experiencing(경험하기) (C)relevant(관련된) — 원문 일치
det.analysis:
(A) dominant: 'lost its dominant role' — 지배적 역할. minor(작은)는 오답.

(B) experiencing: 'based on experiencing as it is on seeing' — 경험하기. observing(관찰)은 오답.

(C) relevant: 'are particularly relevant here' — 관련이 있는. irrelevant(무관한)는 오답.
det.tip: (A)dominant=지배적인. (B)experiencing=경험하기. (C)relevant=관련된. 문화관광은 보는 것만큼 경험에 기반하며, Williams의 정의가 특히 관련이 있다.

② significant: 중요한 — 관련성과 다른 의미.

③ useful: 유용한 — 관련성과 다른 의미.

④ applicable: 적용 가능한 — relevant와 비슷한 의미.
det.tip: relevant(관련된/적절한) ↔ trivial(사소한/하찮은). 접두사(ir-)가 없는 순수 반의어.

questions.passage: Today's cultural tourist is just as likely to be in search of 'popular', 'everyday' or 'street' culture as they are likely to visit a heritage site or a museum. The museum seems to have lost its <u>dominant</u> role as a factory of meaning in (post)modern society, so cultural tourists have gone in search of meaning elsewhere. The predominant direction of expansion has been into 'everyday life'. Cultural tourism is as much based on experiencing as it is on seeing; therefore, Raymond Williams' definitions of culture as a whole way of life as well as the arts and learning are particularly relevant here. Past definitions of cultural tourism have placed too much emphasis on cultural tourism as a form of arts or heritage tourism in its narrowest sense; for example, visiting museums, monuments, galleries and theatres. Cultural tourists are also interested in the more experiential aspects of culture. In an international context, particularly in the context of indigenous or ethnic tourism, the way of life of a people can be a central focus, where the traveller is motivated primarily by first-hand, authentic or intimate contact with people whose ethnic or cultural background is different from their own.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>dominant</u>와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: dominant=지배적인 → secondary(이차적인)이 가장 반대 의미
det.analysis:
① leading: 주도적인 — dominant와 비슷한 의미.

② secondary: 이차적인/부차적인 — dominant(지배적인)의 반의어. ←정답

③ influential: 영향력 있는 — dominant와 비슷한 의미.

④ primary: 주된 — dominant와 비슷한 의미.
det.tip: dominant(지배적인/주된) ↔ secondary(이차적인/부차적인). ①③④은 모두 dominant와 비슷한 의미.

questions.passage:
(A) Past definitions of cultural tourism have <u>placed</u> too much emphasis on cultural tourism as a form of arts or heritage tourism in its narrowest sense.

(B) The traveller visited a special <u>place</u> where indigenous people still follow their traditional way of life.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 place의 의미가 (A)와 (B)에서 각각 어떻게 쓰였는지 가장 잘 설명한 것은?

det.korean: (A) placed = 두다(강조를 두다) (B) place = 장소. 선지① '두다 — 장소'
det.analysis:
① 두다 — 장소: (A) 'placed too much emphasis' = 너무 많은 강조를 두다(put emphasis). (B) 'a special place' = 특별한 장소(location). ←정답

② 강조하다 — 역할: (A)는 placed가 '강조하다' 자체가 아닌 '두다'. 오답.

③ 두다 — 순위: (B)의 place는 순위가 아닌 장소. 오답.

④ 배치하다 — 장소: (A)에서 placed는 '배치'보다는 '두다(put)'의 의미. 오답.
det.tip: place (v): put/두다 — 'place emphasis on'(강조를 두다). place (n): 장소. 다의어는 문맥 파악이 핵심.

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "relating to a group of people who share the same cultural traditions, language, or origins"

det.korean: 같은 문화적 전통/언어/기원을 공유하는 집단과 관련된 = ethnic(민족적/민족의)
det.analysis:
① cultural: 문화적인 — 문화 일반. '같은 기원을 공유하는 집단'보다 넓은 의미.

② historical: 역사적인 — 다른 의미.

③ traditional: 전통적인 — 전통에 관한 것이지 집단 정체성이 아님.

④ ethnic: 민족적인 — 'a group sharing the same cultural traditions, language, or origins' = ethnic group의 정의와 일치. ←정답
det.tip: ethnic=민족의/민족적인. 'ethnic or cultural background' — 본문에 등장하는 단어.

questions.passage: Cultural tourists are also __________ (interest) in the more experiential aspects of culture.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: be interested in: ~에 관심이 있다. interest → interested (형용사)
det.analysis: 'be interested in' = ~에 관심이 있다. 'are interested in' — be동사 뒤에 과거분사형 형용사. interest(동사) → interested(형용사).
det.tip: interesting(흥미로운, 사물 주어) vs interested(관심 있는, 사람 주어). 'tourists are interested in' = 관광객들이 관심이 있다.

questions.passage: In an international context, the traveller is __________ (motivate) primarily by first-hand, authentic or intimate contact with people whose ethnic or cultural background is different from their own.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: be motivated by: ~에 의해 동기부여되다. motivate → motivated (수동태 과거분사)
det.analysis: 'the traveller is motivated by' — 수동태 구조(be + pp). motivate(동사) → motivated(과거분사). '주로 ~에 의해 동기부여된다'.
det.tip: 수동태: be + p.p. motivate → motivated. 'be motivated by + 동기': ~에 의해 동기부여되다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: Williams의 문화 정의 = 예술과 학습뿐 아니라 삶의 전반적인 방식 (whole way of life)
det.analysis:
① historical monuments and galleries: 유산 관광 나열 — Williams의 더 넓은 정의와 반대.

② a whole way of life as well as the arts and learning: Raymond Williams의 문화 정의 원문 일치. ←정답

③ ethnic and indigenous cultural events: 민족 행사 — Williams의 정의 아님.

④ authentic and intimate tourism: 관광 방식 — Williams의 문화 정의 아님.
det.tip: Raymond Williams의 문화 정의: 예술+학습+삶의 방식 전체. 문화관광이 경험에 기반하는 이유를 설명.

a whole way of life as well as the arts and learning

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 여행자의 주된 동기 = 직접적이고 진정한 또는 친밀한 접촉 (first-hand, authentic or intimate contact)
det.analysis:
① visiting heritage sites: 유산 관광지 방문 — 토착 관광의 주된 동기가 아님.

② learning the local language: 언어 학습 — 직접 접촉이 아님.

③ observing traditional arts: 전통 예술 관람 — 관람이지 직접 접촉이 아님.

④ first-hand, authentic or intimate contact: 'traveller is motivated primarily by first-hand, authentic or intimate contact' 원문 일치. ←정답
det.tip: first-hand=직접적인. authentic=진정한. intimate=친밀한. 세 단어 모두 원문에서 함께 등장하는 핵심 표현.

ch: visiting heritage sites and famous museums
learning the local language and customs
observing traditional arts and cultural performances
